description: This Dart file defines the LessonDetailScreen widget for a Flutter app. It displays details of a selected lesson, including title, description, tags, content blocks, and a button to start a quiz. The widget uses Riverpod for state management to access the selected lesson.

classes.name: LessonDetailScreen
classes.description: A widget that displays detailed information about a selected lesson, including content blocks and navigation options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the lesson detail screen, displaying lesson content or a message if none is selected.

methods.name: _chip
methods.description: Helper method to generate a styled chip widget for tags or levels.
